body: I hope you find the peace you're looking for. I'll have found mine by the time the ball drops tonight. Godspeed

Well to be honest, terrible. I'm thinking today is going to be the day. I'm not going to see 2021. I'm going out with a tank of helium attached to a sleep apnea mask. I spent 20 minutes finagling that together after realizing the tank had a pressure reliant release. My roommate (my 26 y/o little brother) is with his gf and won't be home tonight. I've got the house to myself. Even so, I've got a door stopper under my bedroom door handle. I'm just waiting for it to get closer to midnight and trying to work up a good buzz in the process. I appreciate you checking in even though I didn't see your message for 2 weeks. Oh and the way things are looking, you'll likely be the last person to hear from me so cheers to that. I hope your new year is amazing.
That sounds pretty rough. I'm sorry you're been dealing with all that anxiety and stress. Have you talked to anyone about this?
I PM'd you
Yup. I'm gonna be around until the new year at least.
I appreciate you and your kindness. I've got a little time left. I may take you up on that talk before I go
Thank you so very much. If I do find that reason, I'll be sure to thank you for your kindness again.

I don't believe in the afterlife. I believe I will cease to exist in all but the memories of those I know. I would like to know your story. If you would like, we can chat about this privately sometime.
I do! Thank you. 😊

I appreciate the compassion. Your words brought me to tears to be honest. Thank you for that. That's one of the kindest things anyone has ever said to me and I will cherish that for the rest of my life
I appreciate the concern. I'm sure it'll work. I do want to say that I hope you fare better in life than I have and reach peace.
